import traceback

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={
        "default": {
            "ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3",
            "NAME": ":memory:",
        }
    },
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "repro_app",

        "from django.db import models\n"
        "from django.db.models import Manager\n\n\n"
        "class TestTagManager(Manager):\n"
        "    def get_queryset(self):\n"
        "        qs = super().get_queryset()\n"
        "        qs = qs.select_related('master')\n"
        "        return qs\n\n\n"
        "class TestTagMaster(models.Model):\n"
        "    name = models.CharField(max_length=120)\n\n\n"
        "class TestTag(models.Model):\n"
        "    objects = TestTagManager()\n"
        "    name = models.CharField(max_length=120)\n"
        "    master = models.ForeignKey(\n"
        "        TestTagMaster, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True\n"
        "    )\n\n\n"
        "class Test(models.Model):\n"
        "    name = models.CharField(max_length=120)\n"
        "    tags = models.ManyToManyField(TestTag, blank=True)\n"
    )
with open(os.path.join(app_dir, "apps.py"), "w") as f:
    f.write(
        "from django.apps import AppConfig\n\n\n"
        "class ReproAppConfig(AppConfig):\n"
        "    name = 'repro_app'\n"
        "    label = 'repro_app'\n"
    )
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp")

django.setup()

from django.db import connection  # noqa: E402
from django.core import serializers  # noqa: E402
from repro_app.models import Test, TestTag, TestTagMaster  # noqa: E402

with connection.cursor() as c:
    c.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE repro_app_testtagmaster "
        "(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name varchar(120) NOT NULL)"
    )
    c.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE repro_app_testtag "
        "(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name varchar(120) NOT NULL, "
        "master_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES repro_app_testtagmaster(id) "
        "DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)"
    )
    c.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE repro_app_test_tags "
        "(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "
        "test_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repro_app_test(id), "
        "testtag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repro_app_testtag(id))"
    )
    c.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE repro_app_test "
        "(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name varchar(120) NOT NULL)"
    )

tag_master = TestTagMaster.objects.create(name="master")
tag = TestTag.objects.create(name="tag", master=tag_master)
test = Test.objects.create(name="test")
test.tags.add(tag)
test.save()

try:
    data = serializers.serialize("json", [test])
    print("SERIALIZATION OK:", data)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SERIALIZATION FAILED: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
